# proxmox_user (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE user through `/access/users`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_user" "deploy" {
  user_id   = "deploy@pve"
  firstname = "Terraform"
  lastname  = "Bot"
  email     = "bot@example.com"
  password  = "change-me-please"
  groups    = proxmox_group.admins.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Full User ID in `name@realm` format. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional user comment.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable the account (default).
- `expire` (Number) Account expiration date (seconds since epoch). 0 means no expiration.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `groups` (String) Comma-separated list of group IDs.
- `keys` (String) Keys for two-factor auth (yubico).
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Initial password. Proxmox does not report this, so it is not read back.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User identifier (e.g. `name@pam`).
